name: sse-stream
title: SSE frame decoder
description: Server-Sent Events frame decoder over a fetch ReadableStream: frame boundaries (event/data, keepalive comments, CRLF tolerance, chunk buffering) with abort support. The request stays in the host, which owns transport, auth and origin policy; JSON decoding of the data line is the caller's job.
postInstall: Open the stream in the host and pass response.body to consumeSseStream(body, signal, onFrame); JSON decoding of the data line is the caller's job.
